Ohun & Fidio: Media Simulation

Text-based media player simulation using Irosu I/O, Oyeku sleep, and string operations.

Use Case 1: Media Player Controller

// media_player.ifa - Simulate playback controls

ayanmo state = "stopped";
ayanmo position = 0;
ayanmo duration = 300;

ese play() {
    ayanmo state = "playing";
    Irosu.fo("Playing...");
}

ese pause_media() {
    ayanmo state = "paused";
    Irosu.fo("Paused at " + position + "s");
}

ese stop() {
    ayanmo state = "stopped";
    ayanmo position = 0;
    Irosu.fo("Stopped");
}

ese seek_to(seconds) {
    ti (seconds < 0) { ayanmo seconds = 0; }
    ti (seconds > duration) { ayanmo seconds = duration; }
    ayanmo position = seconds;
    Irosu.fo("Seeked to " + position + "s");
}

ese show_progress() {
    ayanmo pct = (position * 100) / duration;
    ayanmo filled = (position * 20) / duration;
    ayanmo bar = "";
    ayanmo i = 0;
    nigba (i < 20) {
        ti (i < filled) {
            ayanmo bar = bar + "#";
        } bibẹkọ {
            ayanmo bar = bar + "-";
        }
        ayanmo i = i + 1;
    }
    Irosu.fo("[" + bar + "] " + pct + "%");
}

// Usage
play();
Oyeku.sun(1000);
seek_to(45);
show_progress();
Oyeku.sun(500);
pause_media();
stop();

Use Case 2: Video Library Browser

// library.ifa - Browse media library

ayanmo library = [];

ese scan_library() {
    ayanmo library = [];
    ayanmo library = Ogunda.fi(library, "intro.mp4");
    ayanmo library = Ogunda.fi(library, "tutorial.mp4");
    ayanmo library = Ogunda.fi(library, "demo.mp4");
    Irosu.fo("Found " + Ogunda.iwọn(library) + " files");
    padap? library;
}

ese show_library(items) {
    Irosu.fo("=== Media Library ===");
    ayanmo i = 0;
    nigba (i < Ogunda.iwọn(items)) {
        Irosu.fo((i + 1) + ". " + items[i]);
        ayanmo i = i + 1;
    }
}

ese select_and_play(items, index) {
    ti (index < 0 || index >= Ogunda.iwọn(items)) {
        Irosu.kigbe("Invalid selection");
        padap?;
    }
    ayanmo file = items[index];
    Irosu.fo("Opening: " + file);
    play();
}

// Usage
ayanmo files = scan_library();
show_library(files);
select_and_play(files, 1);
